page.content:
532 Hippodrome uprising that nearly unseated Justinian.

How Nika riots connects

  • Location: Hippodrome of Constantinople — The Nika riots erupted in and around the Hippodrome.
  • Character: Theodora — Theodora urged Justinian to stay during the Nika riots.
  • Location: Hagia Sophia — The riots destroyed the earlier Hagia Sophia Justinian then rebuilt.

What is Nika riots?

The Nika riots of 532 joined Blue and Green circus factions against Justinian. The Hippodrome burned; Belisarius and Mundus crushed the revolt; Hagia Sophia was rebuilt in the aftermath.

Key threads lead to Hippodrome of Constantinople, Theodora and Hagia Sophia.
